Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Arcturus is moving fast on a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for our inference stack. Procurement asked me to share a concise set of requirements so you can give us a firm commercial posture we can take to our CFO. High level:

- Pilot: 3 months, ~10M tokens/month average during pilot, bursts up to 50M tokens/day during evaluation windows.
- Production target: 200k requests/day, median seq length ~512 tokens, peak latency SLO <120ms p95.
- We need private control plane (VPC), SOC 2 evidence, and a plan for log export to our Splunk instance (api + connector).
- We're sensitive to upfront platform fees; our procurement team wants an amortization option and a pilot credit.
- Support: expect 24x7 for severity-1 after go-live; during pilot 8x5 is fine.
- Target timeline: sign in July, pilot in August, prod by November.

Attached is a short requirements doc. Please include: list pricing for platform fee, suggested amortization schedules (12/9/6 months), recommended support tiers and monthly SRE retainer, and any one-time integration fees (Splunk connector, on-site kickoff). Also call out a realistic usage floor and how burst capacity would be billed.

Procurement contact for contracts: procurement@arcturuslabs.com. Please treat this as a prioritized request; we need a consolidated counter by Tuesday 22 Jun.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Park
Director of Platform Engineering
Arcturus Labs

Irene / team — quick take from pricing: we should avoid a flat 30% platform fee write-off upfront. Recommended move:

1) Pilot concession: offer a $25k pilot credit (one-off) to cover evaluation spikes. Makes sense given their burst pattern and short pilot period.

2) Amortization: propose amortizing the platform fee over 9 months (not 12) to keep visibility into ARR while giving procurement the lower near-term hit they want. Example: list platform fee $150k/year; amortize to effective $120k year-one with the $25k credit applied (math below).

3) Usage floor & burst: set a usage floor at 30% of the committed run-rate for the first 12 months. Burst capacity billed at list but with a 20% cap over expected peak during the pilot month-to-month. That protects us from unbounded bursts.

4) Support: include Support Silver for the first 6 months (8x5 ticketing + 2 on-calls/month) as part of the counter. After 6 months, Gold (24x7) can be added for $12k/yr extra.

5) One-time integrations: charge $8k for the Splunk connector and $6k for an optional on-site kickoff (travel + 1 PM week).

6) Legal/compliance: provide SOC 2 link and a standard addendum; legal fine with a standard SOC2 non-prod evidence pack — procurement often accepts a timebound staging review instead of on-site audit.

Approve deeper discounts only with finance sign-off. If they insist on 30% upfront on list, require a 24-month minimum commit or a stepped credit schedule.

Suggested collateral to send: counter PDF + DocuSign link + HubSpot deal id DL-2027-ARCT-003. I'll draft a short internal pricing note you can paste into the counter.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
